title: D38 vLLM live recapture - measured deployment baseline

d38_root_precondition.consequence: served root is NOT the released snapshot: this is a DEPLOYMENT baseline. It cannot be joined to the frozen D41/D38 released-root oracle; distributional parity needs a capture on the released snapshot, which needs a GPU window (vLLM restart under Lead authorization).

gate_eligible_reasons: served root is not the D38 released root, so rows cannot be joined to the frozen released-root oracle (D38 precondition NOT MET)
co-tenant load observed (num_requests_running up to 5.0); latency is under-load, not a single-stream baseline
